data.name: Sands of Fate
data.detailed_description:
SANDS OF FATE IS IN ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT! JOIN OUR GROWING DISCORD COMMUNITY TO STAY CONNECTED! 

Sands of Fate is a grimdark fantasy survival sandbox MMORPG set in the scarred world of Elarin - a reborn realm still reeling from the cataclysmic consequences of an ancient god's obsession with the Weave of Creation. His failed cosmic experiments shattered the pristine continent of Aolea, leaving behind a fractured world of survivors who must rebuild their civilizations and combat the ongoing threat of the Strand - a terrifying, physical manifestation of the Weave's failed self-repair. The Strand spreads unchecked, swallowing everything in it's path. 

Built on over five years of world-building, Sands of Fate is designed for roleplayers, by roleplayers - we're reaching far beyond the boundaries of traditional survival games to offer absolute agency in a dangerous sandbox. 

GAME FEATURES: 

★ Absolute Freedom (Zero-gating): Play your way. Quest, Build, Fight. In any order. Power is earned through survival, not quest progression. 

★ Design your own Class: Master a combat style of your own choosing. Select a primary archetype and dominate your enemies, or hybridize your playstyle by learning a secondary archetype for an entirely unique playstyle. 

★ Pantheon of Flawed Gods: Align with or defy a pantheon of deep emotionally complex deities. Build a reputation with specific gods to directly impact the world, its factions, and the environment that you engage with. 

★ Robust Race Selection: Spanning humanoid, beastkin and faekin, the races of Elarin are deeply rooted in the history of the world, and how they have survived the cataclysm. 

★ Player-driven Economy & Societies: Dive into complex professions that entice players to collaborate, trade, and build thriving economies as they rebuild the civilization of Elarin. 

★ Clans, Territory, and Building Systems: Players band together, claim land and build fortified bases against the Strand. Leaving a permanent, visible mark on the scarred continents of Elarin. 

★ Unparalleled Customization Options: Stand out in grim world, with an in-depth cosmetic and character customization system that rewards lore-hunters, and adventurers alike with distinct visual styles, skins and titles to express your character's identity. 

★ Learn Aol, the Language of the Gods: Immerse yourself fully in the roleplay experience. Learn, decipher, and actively speak Aol - a fully custom-built language that is integrated directly into the world's secrets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Cores i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 31200
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6Gb) / AMD Radeon 5600XT (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Required
